meta.name: output-quality-rubrics
meta.description: Defining what "good" looks like for AI outputs — accuracy, relevance, helpfulness.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义AI输出的质量标准，提升准确性与相关性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为AI输出制定清晰的质量准则
copy.tagline_en: Define quality standards for AI outputs to improve accuracy and relevance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to define clear quality criteria for AI outputs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照准确、相关、完整、有用、清晰、语气恰当、安全等维度来评估和优化自己的输出，并可能给出评分和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 评估输出质量，或请它按照特定标准改进回答时触发。

say.text: 请根据准确、相关、完整等标准，评估我的这段文案。
say.note: Claude 会给出各维度评分和改进建议。

say.text: 按照1-5分，检查你刚才回答的准确性和完整性。
say.note: Claude 会自查并报告分数及理由。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude evaluates and refines its outputs based on dimensions like accuracy, relevance, completeness, helpfulness, clarity, tone appropriateness, and safety, optionally providing scores and improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to evaluate output quality or to improve a response according to specific criteria.

say_en.text: Evaluate this text based on accuracy, relevance, and completeness.
say_en.note: Claude will provide scores and suggestions for each dimension.

say_en.text: Score your previous answer on a 1-5 scale for each quality criterion.
say_en.note: Claude will self-assess and report scores and justifications.
